title: company coverage.yaml: every required item of an attached question set is answered, marked na, or listed as open (CR-125)

ruleset.$comment: the classification rules the file was written under (contract section 9)

id.$comment: the id the attached question set gives the item; the profile repository holds none

facet.$comment: one of the nine facets, or the group name a question set uses for items that belong to none (for example brands, sources, layers)

where.$comment: <file in _company/>[:line], where the answer is stated; required for answered, partial, conflict

reason.$comment: required for na, open, decision, workshop; and for any item classed below the one a looser reader would choose

close_with.$comment: required for open: us = material we can read or fetch; customer = a fact only the company holds

remainder.$comment: required for partial: what the missing part needs
